newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: W&K says NZ Rural Props takeover supported.
newsitem.headline: W&K says NZ Rural Props takeover supported.

text.p: Williams & Kettle said on Friday shareholders passed a resolution authorising the issue of shares for its takeover offer for NZ Rural Properties.
The vote taken by poll at an extraordinary meeting showed strong support, with 79.4 percent in favour of the resolution.
This excluded 27 percent of total shares not eligible to vote.
The shareholder vote followed the support for the offer shown earlier by WKL independent directors and by the Price Waterhouse appraisal report.
Following the meeting, W&K waived the due diligence condition and extended the offer period to NZRP shareholders by 14 days to September 19.
WKL said considerable efficiencies could be gained by combining the head offices and some board and management functions of the two companies.
The result, he said, would be enhanced long-term profitability and shareholder value.
